actualMechanism: Generic scope calls Persistence.transaction("dashboard") and every callback return is commit:false. It does not invoke C08 state.transaction or Atlas append.
LocalStore transaction uses operation(true) and BEGIN IMMEDIATE; this reserves the writer slot. It is NOT a SQLite read-only or lock-free transaction.

Nested actual Surface reads use the same LocalStore root and defensive snapshots. commit:true, nested blob writes and other nested writers poison the root and fail; the source-lifecycle wrapper retains this behavior.
C08 state.read performs real namespace authorization before and after reads. Canonical Atlas recall only reads; its append/state.transaction path is not introduced into this grouping.

The eligibility predicate excludes a second business domain and calculations. All returned business sources are Procurement, with protected C08/case/Atlas metadata. Domain mutations and central append remain separate; no global atomicity is promised.
T01T07Compatibility.conclusion: No concrete new T01/T07 source conflict found for this narrow eligible path. Do not generalize it to mixed-domain consumers or metadata writers. Writer reservation/latency must be measured in hosted execution.
